topics.title: Retry budget
topics.summary: Requests stop retrying after three attempts.

blastRadius.note: A failed request could stop before a later attempt succeeds.

notes.summary: The first call consumes one attempt, keeping the retry budget finite.
notes.rationale: Counting only retries would allow a fourth call.

writeup.tldr: Requests that kept failing retried without end and held the request loop. Each request now stops after three attempts, as the retry PRD asks.
writeup.overview:
- **Goal:** Failed requests must stop retrying.
- **Change:** Each request gets three attempts.
writeup.whereToLook:
- **Biggest risk:** An early stop could discard the final attempt.
- **Check first:** Read `src/retry.ts` in Retry budget.
writeup.context:
- The request loop and its PRD change.
- No new dependency.
- The retry budget follows `docs/adr/2026-07-01-retries.md`.

glossary.definition: The total number of attempts allowed for one request.

retry-budget.why:
**What it is:** The request loop retries temporary failures.

**Problem:** Repeated failures kept the loop running.

**Fix:** The loop stops after three attempts.
retry-budget.example:
A request fails on every attempt.

| Input | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Repeated temporary failure | Retries continue | Stops after attempt three |
retry-budget.body: - The first call counts as attempt one. ref A - A successful attempt ends the loop immediately. - Check that the third attempt can still succeed. - The retry budget follows `docs/adr/2026-07-01-retries.md`, section Consistency model.
